title: prefill-decode: chunked speculative prefill + stage-overlap kernel scheduler & KV-cache improvements
author: Aditi Sharma
description:
Motivation: In long-sequence workloads the prefill stage often becomes a bottleneck and limits the effectiveness of continuous batching and KV cache reuse. This PR implements a combined approach: chunked prefill + speculative prefill + stage-overlap execution, and couples those changes with kernel-scheduler heuristics and KV-cache prefetching to maximize GPU utilization while keeping tail-latency under SLOs.

Changes in this PR: (1) Chunked prefill: split large prefill sequences into fixed-size chunks (configurable, default=512 tokens) so that downstream decode can begin earlier and smaller work items can be scheduled more flexibly. (2) Speculative prefill: allow a lightweight speculative run that computes KV shards for likely next chunks based on model tokenization heuristics; speculative work is prioritized but can be discarded safely on mismatch. (3) Stage-overlap: allow prefill chunk completion to trigger decode stage work for already-ready batches; runtime now supports overlap of prefill/decode pipelines per-device. (4) Kernel scheduler: new heuristics added to runtime/kernel_scheduler.rs to prefer interleaving small decode kernels with leftover prefill chunk kernels to reduce idle warp time; added backpressure signals to avoid oversubscription. (5) KV-cache improvements: prefetch hooks added to runtime/kv_cache.rs so chunked prefill populates per-request KV segments earlier; added LRU trimming tuned for speculative chunks. (6) Continuous batching integration: batching heuristics updated to be chunk-aware and to respect the new stage-overlap signals; micro-batching path updated to avoid head-of-line blocking. (7) Benchmarks and tests: new perf suite and integration tests (benchmarks/prefill_decode_bench.py) and unit tests for speculative path and scheduler.

Design notes and tradeoffs: speculative prefill increases GPU work but reduces end-to-end latency for high-certainty next-chunk cases; heuristics cap speculative work per-device to avoid wasted cycles. Chunk size is tunable and experiments show diminishing returns beyond 1024 tokens. Stage-overlap yields best improvements when KV cache hit-rate is >40% and for models with medium-sized context windows.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear (ENG-5123) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Perf microbench results attached - [x] Feature guarded behind runtime config flag (prefill_stage_overlap=true)

Risk: moderate - changes touch core runtime scheduling and KV cache. Feature is disabled by default and gated by flags. Rollout plan: enable in canary pool -> monitor tail-latency and token throughput -> gradually roll out to larger pools.

review_comments: Evan Chen: Nice work. Two things: (1) can we make the speculative budget per-device configurable and expose telemetry for wasted speculative work? (2) scheduler heuristics look promising but please add a safety net to prevent decode starvation.

Author (Aditi): Replied: added per-device speculative_budget config and instrumentation counters (runtime.metrics.speculative_waste) and added a decode-starvation guard that forces decode priority if prefill backlog exceeds threshold.
Lukas Meyer: Please add a regression test for KV-cache trimming so we don't evict active segments needed by decode; also clarify LRU policy in docs.
Author (Aditi): Replied: added tests/tests_persistent_kv_trim.rs and expanded docs/perf/prefill-decode-optimizations.md to describe LRU tuning and eviction heuristics.
Priya Natarajan (approve): Verified perf improvements on canary; tail-p99 latency improved and throughput increased for our summarization workload. Approving for merge with rollout notes.

release_notes: Runtime: improve prefill-decode latency and throughput via chunked + speculative prefill, stage-overlap execution, kernel-scheduler heuristics, and KV-cache prefetching. Feature is default-off and gated behind runtime prefills_stage_overlap flag. See docs/perf/prefill-decode-optimizations.md for tuning guidance.
